notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Skullwinder each turn.
description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Skullwinder by paying its mana cost.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Skullwinder from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
